title: Electron-Density-Informed Molecular Property Prediction Using Surrogate Functionals
abstract: arXiv:2610.13649v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning methods are increasingly used to predict chemical properties directly from the molecular structure to bypass the often prohibitive cost of quantum mechanical calculations. Recent work has shown that including the ground-state electron density as input to the machine learning model can improve accuracy in this setting. This work employs the recent surrogate functional framework originally developed for orbital-free density functional theory and extends it to predicting molecular properties. We show that passing the ground-state density as input to the model, while simultaneously enforcing it to be the minimum of the surrogate functional, surpasses state-of-the-art performance for six out of seven extensive properties of the QM9 dataset. translated_title: 基于替代泛函的电子密度信息分子性质预测
translated_abstract: 机器学习方法正越来越多地被用于直接从分子结构预测化学性质，以绕过量子力学计算中常常令人望而却步的成本。近期研究表明，将基态电子密度作为机器学习模型的输入可以提高此类任务的预测精度。本工作采用了最初为无轨道密度泛函理论开发的替代泛函框架，并将其扩展到分子性质预测任务中。我们证明，将基态密度作为输入传递给模型，同时强制该密度成为替代泛函的最小值，在QM9数据集的七个广延性质中有六个超越了最先进的性能。此外，该方法在来自QM40数据集的更大分子上表现出更好的泛化能力。在两个数据集的所有广延性质上，我们的方法均优于现有模型。
tldr: 该方法将基态电子密度作为模型输入并强制其满足替代泛函最小化条件，在QM9和QM9数据集的广延分子性质预测上超越了现有最先进模型，并在更大分子上展现出更强的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: By feeding the ground-state electron density into the model while enforcing it to be the minimum of a surrogate functional, this approach surpasses state-of-the-art performance on extensive molecular property prediction across the QM9 and QM40 datasets with improved generalization to larger molecules.
